acceptanceCriteria.description: Given a task that cannot start until another completes, When it is written, Then task.json records that dependency in a field the schema defines.
Given a phase's tasks, When nit:tasks presents its summary, Then the dependency graph it is instructed to show is derived from recorded data rather than from prose or memory.
Given a recorded dependency naming a task that does not exist, When the task is validated, Then it fails rather than accepting an unresolvable reference.
Given the new field, When it is added, Then something reads it, proven by test (ADR-0007).
